items.title: 75230_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I was listening to Roy, too; I could hear him from Chicago. And I had kind of changed a little bit from Louis to Roy, because I liked Roy and I liked what he was playing

ctx.x: you could liken it to any style that we know? Was it a little like Roy Eldridge?

Well, he was just as modern as Roy was in them days. But he didn't play like Roy. He had a nice sound, though. He had a nice tone. And he could play. I used to marvel at him. I used to say, "I wish I could play like that."
And he was going with Harriet Calloway...
